title: Lost Vape Ultra Boost Coils - 5 Coils
description: Explore a wide variety of vaping experiences with these replacement Ultra Boost Coils compatible with the Lost Vape Thelema kit. These coils can be used for both MTL (mouth-to-lung) and DTL (direct-to-lung) vaping styles. Their simple ‘plug and play’ mechanism makes them a breeze to use: simply push the coil into the space at the base of the pod. Ultra Boost MTL Coil 1.0ohm Coil resistance: 1.0ohm Regular Coil Rate: 8-15W Suitable for MTL use High PG , 50/50, Nic Salts E-Liquids Ultra Boost M3 Coil 0.15ohm Coil resistance: 0.15ohm mesh coil Rate 40-70W Suitable for DL Use High VG 70% or above (sub Ohm) E-Liquid Ultra Boost M2 Coil 0.6ohm Coil resistance: 0.6ohm Mesh Coil Rate: 20-28W Suitable for DL Use High VG 70% or above (sub Ohm) or Nic Salts E-Liquid Ultra Boost M1 Coil 0.3ohm Coil resistance: 0.3ohm mesh coil Rate: 30-40W Suitable for DL Use High VG 70% or above (sub Ohm) E-Liquid Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
